seoTitle: Rule of 40 Calculator for SaaS Growth and Profit
metaDescription: Add yearly revenue growth and a profit margin to see whether the total reaches 40. Free and private.
intro: Adds growth rate and a profit margin to check the Rule of 40.
why:
The Rule of 40 says growth rate plus profit margin should be at least 40 percent for a healthy software company. It lets a company trade growth against profit.

Choose one margin definition, such as EBITDA or free cash flow, and keep it the same over time. The rule is a rough guide, mostly used for scaled companies.
howTo: Enter the margin and pick its type.

faq.a: The one your investors use; just stay consistent.

faq.q: Does it apply to early startups?
faq.a: Less so. Early on, growth matters more.
No, it is a rule of thumb.
